Mandatory ISO Certification: The offered trolley suitcase shall be from a valid ISO-certified entity a s on the date of bid submission and throughout the applicable contract period. Expired, suspended or withdrawn certificates shall not be accepted. The Purchaser rese rves the right to verify the certificate directly with the certification body/accreditation database. 13. Brand Authenticity: The bidder shall supply only 100% genuine, brand-new and original specified pr oduct. Refurbished, used, repaired, duplicate, counterfeit or otherwise unauthorized products shall not be accepted. The Purchaser reserves the right to verify the brand and product authenticity from brand specific, its authorized channel or supporting commercial documents. 14. Product Technical Compliance: The bidder shall submit a point-by-point Technical Compliance Stat ement against all specifications mentioned in the tender. The supplied product shall strictly conform to the approved technical specifications and the approved sample. 15. Product Sample: The bidder shall submit a physical sample of the quoted specified trolley suitcase b efore the bid closing date, wherever required by the Purchaser. Failure to submit the sample within the stipulated time shall make the bid liable for rejection. 16. Sample Inspection & Evaluation: The Purchaser reserves the right to inspect and evaluate the sub mitted sample for brand, material, finish, dimensions, workmanship, appearance, quality and conformi ty with the technical specifications. Submission of a sample shall not confer any right on the bidder for final acceptance.

17. No Change After Sample Approval: After approval of the sample, the bidder shall not change the b rand, model, material, construction, design, manufacturing source or product configuration without pri or written approval of the Purchaser. 18. Product Traceability & Packaging: The product/packaging shall, wherever applicable, contain the s pecified brand name, product/model details, manufacturer/marketer details, MRP, batch/lot details and other legally required declarations. Products shall be supplied in original and suitable packaging to pre vent damage during transportation, handling and storage. 19. Quality & Inspection: The Purchaser reserves the right to inspect the goods at the time of delivery o r thereafter to verify quality, quantity, brand, specifications, workmanship, packaging and conformity with the approved sample. Any product not conforming to the tender requirements may be rejected or replaced at the bidder's cost. 20. Replacement of Defective/Non-Conforming Goods: Any product found defective, damaged, brok en, manufacturing-defective, incomplete, non-functional, or different from the approved sample/specifi cation shall be replaced free of cost within the period stipulated by the Purchaser. 21. Payment – No Advance: No advance payment shall be made. Payment shall be released only after s atisfactory delivery, inspection and acceptance of the goods in accordance with the tender conditions. 22. Payment Linked to Quality Acceptance: Payment shall be released within 45 days period of Gem I nvoice Submission only after satisfactory delivery and confirmation of quantity, brand, quality, approve d sample and conformity with the technical specifications. Delivery alone shall not constitute final acce ptance. 23. Statutory Compliance: The bidder shall comply with all applicable laws, rules and regulations, includ ing GST, Income Tax, Legal Metrology, Consumer Protection requirements and other applicable statuto ry requirements relating to the product and supply. 24.
